cls_rules.query_type: per-query class from tables.query_type[type of the CreateQuery that made `this`]
cls_rules.taint: per-resource-level bit pix_taint. Content read back through a lock (read of Lock/LockRect/LockBox/GetDC) is pix iff the bit is set for that level, else det. Initially set for: objects created with D3DUSAGE_RENDERTARGET or D3DUSAGE_DEPTHSTENCIL, CreateRenderTarget/CreateDepthStencilSurface surfaces, swap-chain back buffers, the auto depth-stencil, levels >= 1 of D3DUSAGE_AUTOGENMIPMAP textures. Changed by methods listed in tables.taint (effects[] of the method). Lock bytes of a non-tainted level are the application's own earlier writes (det).

box_d.meaning: b.Back-b.Front of the D3DBOX param, or the 2nd arg when NULL

box_h.meaning: b.Bottom-b.Top of the D3DBOX param, or the 2nd arg when NULL

box_w.meaning: b.Right-b.Left of the D3DBOX param, or the 2nd arg when NULL

decl_bytes.meaning: 8 * elements of D3DVERTEXELEMENT9 at ptr up to and including the first with Stream==0xFF

if.meaning: second arg when first is nonzero else third

lvl.meaning: max(1, dim >> level): size of a mip level

nonnull.meaning: 1 if the pointer parameter is not NULL

ok.meaning: arg if SUCCEEDED(hr) else 0 (only in rules evaluated after the call)

ok0.meaning: arg if hr == S_OK else 0 (S_FALSE and failures give 0)

pd_iunknown.meaning: 1 if the private data stored on `this` under the GUID parameter was set with D3DSPD_IUNKNOWN (state from SetPrivateData)

rect_h.meaning: r.bottom-r.top of the RECT param, or the 2nd arg when NULL

rect_w.meaning: r.right-r.left of the RECT param, or the 2nd arg when the param is NULL

rowbytes.meaning: bytes of one row (block row) of an image w pixels wide in D3DFORMAT fmt

rows.meaning: rows (block rows) of an image h pixels high in D3DFORMAT fmt (tables.format)

sm_bytes.meaning: bytes of the shader token stream at ptr: version token .. END token 0x0000FFFF inclusive (tables.sm_walk)

str_bytes.meaning: bytes of the NUL-terminated 8-bit string at ptr, terminator included

u32.meaning: little-endian DWORD at byte offset (2nd arg) of the buffer at ptr

verts.meaning: vertex count of primitive_count primitives of D3DPRIMITIVETYPE; 0 when count is 0 (tables.primitive)

wstr_bytes.meaning: bytes of the NUL-terminated UTF-16 string at ptr, terminator included

object_props.data_size: query_type table size of the CreateQuery type
object_props.decl_bytes: decl_bytes() of the elements given to CreateVertexDeclaration
object_props.shader_bytes: sm_bytes() of the bytecode given to Create*Shader

D3DQUERYTYPE_CACHEUTILIZATION.why: cache hit rates measured during execution

D3DQUERYTYPE_EVENT.why: TRUE once the GPU consumed the stream: depends on GPU timing

D3DQUERYTYPE_INTERFACETIMINGS.why: GPU/driver utilisation percentages: wall-clock timing statistics

D3DQUERYTYPE_OCCLUSION.why: samples passed: depends on rendered pixels

D3DQUERYTYPE_PIPELINETIMINGS.why: GPU/driver utilisation percentages: wall-clock timing statistics

D3DQUERYTYPE_PIXELTIMINGS.why: GPU/driver utilisation percentages: wall-clock timing statistics

D3DQUERYTYPE_RESOURCEMANAGER.why: driver resource-manager statistics: depend on memory pressure and GPU timing

D3DQUERYTYPE_TIMESTAMPFREQ.why: GPU clock frequency: a property of the device

D3DQUERYTYPE_VCACHE.why: post-transform vertex cache description of the GPU/driver (fixed per device model)

D3DQUERYTYPE_VERTEXTIMINGS.why: GPU/driver utilisation percentages: wall-clock timing statistics
